name: ethereal_elk_finds_vivien_in_library
notes: P5b5749e9f4 G4. Printed: 'When this creature enters, you may search your library and/or graveyard for a card named Vivien, Nature's Avenger, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.' Seat 0 casts Ethereal Elk ({3}{G}{G}, spent exactly); it accepts the may and searches the library only (option 1 of: both zones, library, graveyard). The card named Vivien, Nature's Avenger goes to hand; a decoy planeswalker named Vivien Reid stays in the library, and the library (shuffled) still holds the six filler cards and the decoy.
